name: Wooden stake
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 179
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 179
Statistics
Cost — Weight 1 lb.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range 10 ft.; Type P; Special —
Category Light; Proficiency Simple
Weapon Groups Close
Description
This close combat weapon is just a sharpened piece of wood. Iron spikes that are used as weapons deal damage as wooden stakes.
